comment: Provenance pin for the zero-shot label set. Paths are derived from photo-tools src/photo_tools/data/ram_tag_mapping.yaml (Objects/* and Scenes/*). The yaml itself is not vendored. taxonomy_paths.txt is the deterministic path list; labels.py refuses a mapping that drifts. labels_json_sha256 is the hash of the last pack's labels.json (schema/dim/path/prompt), produced with sort_keys JSON.

source.note: Public clone was not resolvable from this environment; pin the git commit locally with lock_taxonomy.py when a checkout exists.
